---
title: geom-ribbon
subtitle: Filled band between `ymin` and `ymax` along the x aesthetic.
category: Geoms
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


The mapping must provide `x`, `ymin`, and `ymax`. Rows are sorted by x
and the polygon is closed between the lower and upper boundaries.

## Usage

```typst
geom-ribbon(
  mapping: none,
  data: none,
  fill: auto,
  stroke: none,
  alpha: 0.3,
  stat: "identity",
  position: "identity",
  inherit-aes: true,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mapping` | `none` | Layer-specific aesthetic mapping built with [`aes`](../core/aes.qmd). Must map `x`, `ymin`, `ymax`. |
| `data` | `none` | Layer-specific dataset. Falls back to the plot data when `none`. |
| `fill` | `auto` | Band fill colour. `auto` resolves via the fill scale or a neutral default. |
| `stroke` | `none` | Band outline; `none` means no border. |
| `alpha` | `0.3` | Band opacity in `[0, 1]`. |
| `stat` | `"identity"` | Statistical transform name. Usually `"identity"`. |
| `position` | `"identity"` | Position adjustment name. Usually `"identity"`. |
| `inherit-aes` | `true` | Whether to merge the plot-level mapping into this layer's mapping. |

## Returns

Layer dictionary consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/geom-ribbon-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 10).map(i => (
  x: i,
  lo: i * 0.5 - 1,
  hi: i * 0.5 + 1,
))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", ymin: "lo", ymax: "hi"),
  layers: (geom-ribbon(alpha: 0.3),),
)
```

[`geom-smooth`](geom-smooth.qmd), [`geom-line`](geom-line.qmd).
